purpose: Use the independent TAGRO warehouse as the first historical/structural evidence source without mistaking warehouse-derived classifications for current canonical truth.
invariants: Warehouse data is evidence and history, not automatic current truth.
Warehouse-derived branch status remains explicitly warehouse-derived until reconciled with current sources.
Source run identity and database digest must accompany every exported observation package.
Phase 1 exports branch observations only; person observations wait for current OS/Service/TD sources.
No exporter writes to warehouse databases.
No import package may directly mutate canonical branches, principals, users or memberships.
Conflicts are preserved for reconciliation rather than overwritten.
Later live branch connectors are separate sources and do not erase warehouse history.
next_sources: branch folders and current information banks
